atra ādyēna ślōkapadatrayēṇēṣṭadēvatānamaskāraṁ karōtyācāryō’parēṇa caturthēna
saṁbandhādikathanam । yasmātkriyārambhē vighnavināyakōpasargōpaśamāya śiṣṭā iṣṭadēvatā
namaskāraṁ kurvanti । tatō’rthādinidhērdharmasya vr̥ddhiradharmasya hānira (+ta) statprabha
vānāṁ(ṇāṁ) vighnādi(dī)nāmupaśamaḥ । kāraṇābhāvē kāryasyāpyabhāvāt ।
tatō’bhīṣṭārthasiddhiriti । tadgāyatraṁ gāyatrābhidhānaṁ chandō naumi staumi । gāya
tryēva gāyatram । prajñāditvātsvārthēprajādi aṇ (pā° 5.4.38) athavā cchandasaḥ
pratyayavidhānō napuṁsakātsvārthā ityaṇ । kīdr̥k । chandasāṁ pūrvam । chandasāmuṣṇi
gādīnāṁ pūrvamādyaṁ prathamaṁ pradhānaṁ ca । chandōkṣarāṇāmiyattāviśēṣa iti । tathā
varddhamānākṣaraṁ param । na kēvalaṁ gāyatraṁ naumi । yāvatparamanantarapaṭhitaṁ uṣṇigādi
cchandaḥ utkr̥tiparyantamapi naumi । athavā paraṁ pradhānaṁ dēvatātmakatvāt । kīdr̥k ।
vardhamānākṣaram । vardhamānamadhikībhavadakṣaraṁ balaṁ yasminyasya vā tadvardhamānākṣaraṁ
uṣṇigādicchandaḥ । athavā vardhamānānyakṣarāṇi yataḥ tadvarddhamānākṣaraṁ gāyatram ।
vāṅmaṇḍanakaram । vācāṁ maṇḍanaṁ vāṅmaṇḍanam । tadavaśyaṁ karōtīti kr̥ñō hētutā
cchīlyē ṭaḥ । girāmalaṁkaraṇaṁ bhūṣaṇakarambhaṣaṇakaram ।
kēyūrāṇi na bhūṣayantibhaṣayanti puruṣaṁpuruṣāṁ hārāśca candraprabhāḥcanda
nanāsnānaṁ snānaṁ na ca varṇakō na kusumaṁ nākuṇṭhitā mūrddhajāḥ ।
ēkā vāksamalaṁkarōti puruṣaṁ yā saṁskr̥taṁ bhāṣatē
kṣīyantē kila bhūṣaṇānyamaraṇānyamarahō vāgbhūṣaṇaṁ tvakṣayam ॥
saṁskārakamityanarthāntaram । kimartham । citravr̥ttaprasiddhayē । citrāṇi ca
tāni vr̥ttāni citravr̥ttāni nānāprakārāṇi akṣaravinyāsarūpāṇi tanumadhyādīni
tēṣāṁ prasiddhayē niṣpattayē pratipattyartham । tādarthyē ca caturthī । athavā vardhamānākṣarā
bhidhānamācāryaṁrāvidhāna naumi । kīdr̥śam । gāyatram । gāyantītigāyantiti gāyāḥ śiṣyāstāṁstrā
yata iti gāyatram । spaṣṭamanyat । anēna ca dēvatāstutipūrvaṁ stōtr̥janapravartananimittaṁstōtrajana
saṁbandhādikathanaṁ vidadhāti । tatratat sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇaḥ saṁbandhaḥ vācyavācakalakṣaṇō
vā । chandāṁsyabhidhēyāni । tatparijñānaṁ prayōjanam । vaidikā(+nā)mupasthānādau
viniyuktānāṁ gāyatryādīnāṁ parijñānasya puruṣārthasādhanavidhi ēdhirvyaṁpadhivya (?)
dhikāritvasaṁpattyā svargādyavāptiprayōjanamiti ।tathā ca chandō’jñānasyānadhikāra
śrutiriyaṁ darśayati । yō hi vā aviditārṣēyacchandōdaivatabrāhmaṇēna mantrēṇa yājayati
vā adhyāpayati vā sthāṇuṁ vāṁchati (vārchati ?) gaṁttaṁ (gartaṁ ?) vā prapadyatē pra
vā mīyatē । pāpīyānsa bhavati yātayāmānyasya cchandāṁsi bhavantīti । tasmādvi
duṣō’dhikāraḥ । vidvattāvidvitā ca ṣaḍaṅgavēdavēdanēnaṣaḍaṅgōvēda । idaṁ vēdāṅgam । tathā cōktam ।
śikṣā kalpō vyākaraṇaṁ niruktaṁ jyōtiṣāṁ gatiḥ ।
cchandōdhi(vi)citiṣaṣṭhaścaṣasvaścaṣaṣvaśca ṣaḍaṅgō vēda ucyatē ॥

piṇḍitēṣu miśrīkr̥tēṣumisraiḥ satsu catuḥṣaṣṭyākhyā saṁkhyā bhavati kīdr̥śī । prastā
rēṇa gurulaghuvinyāsēna viracitā । athavā uddiṣṭavidhānāṅkaiḥ ēkadvicaturaṣṭaṣō
ḍaśadvātriṁśadrūpaiḥ saikaiḥ ēkādhikaiḥ miśraiḥ piṇḍīkr̥taiḥ saiva catuḥṣaṣṭyākhyā
saṁkhyā bhavati ॥ 11 ॥

ṣaḍakṣarasya vr̥ttasya catuḥṣaṣṭyākhyā saṁkhyā dvābhyāṁ
samāhr̥tā dviguṇitā aṣṭāviṁśaṁaṣṭāviṁśatamityarthaḥ śatamityarthaḥ । ēkēna rūpēṇāṅkēna varjitā śūnyāstanyā
śataṁsataṁ saptaviṁśatyadhikamityarthaḥ । ēvaṁvidhō’dhvayōgaḥ adhvasaṁbandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।
kīdr̥śaḥ । chinnavr̥ttaṁ gurulaghusamudāyō yasyāḥ tādr̥śī aṅgulamānēna vyāptiraṅgu
lavyāptiḥ yasya sa tathōkta iti siddham ॥ 12 ॥
